settings.title: Settings
settings.host_pattern: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.host_format: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.public_address_tooltip: Announced to participants, not bound locally, so a NAT address is correct here. Detected at install; change it if a port forward uses a different address.
settings.private_address_tooltip: Only needed when participants also connect from the local network. The server then announces both addresses, so internal clients do not depend on NAT hairpinning.
settings.udp_ports_description: Audio and video travel over UDP on the range {range}, not over HTTPS. Participants cannot connect unless it is reachable from the internet. The rule on this node is created automatically; forward the range on any router in front of it.
settings.stun_server_tooltip: Leave empty unless you run your own. A public STUN server receives the IP address of every participant.
settings.turn_ext_server_tooltip: Participants behind a firewall that blocks UDP cannot join without TURN. This app does not provide one.
settings.enable_recording_tooltip: Captures audio, video, chat, shared notes and presentations. Tell participants before you enable it.
settings.recording_max_age_days_invalid: Enter a whole number of days, at least 1
settings.welcome_message: Message shown in the chat when a meeting starts
settings.welcome_footer: Footer appended to the welcome message
settings.bigbluebutton_fqdn_tooltip: The name participants will type. It must resolve to this server and have a certificate the browser trusts: without one, browsers refuse microphone and camera access.
settings.remove_old_recording_tooltip: Deletion runs from the maintenance job, every 30 minutes.
settings.sounds_language_tooltip: Language of the spoken announcements inside a conference. The sound pack is downloaded on first start.
settings.welcome_message_tooltip: Shown in the chat when a meeting starts. Simple HTML is accepted.
settings.certificate_mismatch_title: The certificate does not match this hostname
settings.certificate_mismatch_description: Traefik serves a certificate issued for another name. Greenlight cannot reach the API and browsers will refuse microphone and camera access. Request a Let's Encrypt certificate above, or upload one for this hostname from Settings > TLS certificates.
settings.default_admin_title: The default administrator password is still in use
settings.default_admin_description: This instance was created with a bootstrap administrator, admin@nethserver.org, whose password is Nethesis,1234. That password ships with this module and is therefore known to anyone. Sign in with it at {url}, create your own account, give it the Administrator role, then change or delete the bootstrap one.
